<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Hydra](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=499)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 164

The most commonly seen hydra famously has five heads that it uses in unison to attack prey or assailants. Scattered across the Inner Sea region are more fantastical breeds of the beast, each with their own curious evolution and hunting behavior.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Hydra](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3064) (Creature 6), [Mocking Chorus](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3296) (Creature 18), [Prismhydra](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3295) (Creature 16), [Stargut Hydra](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3293) (Creature 9), [Tyrafdir](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3294) (Creature 11)
